## Pull request

- [ ] `python -m app.plugin_lint` is clean
- [ ] `python -m pytest` is clean
- [ ] Skill bodies stay product-neutral
- [ ] No `commands/`, `agents/`, or `hooks/`
- [ ] Owner's pull request: opened ready for review, merges itself when the required check passes. Anyone else: waits for the owner after the agent safety review
- [ ] Ticket links use `Refs #N`
- [ ] `## Plan`, `## Evidence` (`VERIFY_*`), and `Door:` present when using `pr`
